verdict.rationale: Deel documents webhooks that deliver real-time notifications for key platform events, secured with HMAC-SHA256 signatures. A user can build event-triggered actions on top of them, for example by having an external service or agent call the API or MCP tools. However, the evidence shows no native rule or workflow builder for defining 'if event X then do Y' inside Deel, so automation requires custom integration code. Missing for 10: a native rules/automation engine, documented event-to-action configuration, a list of supported trigger events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
